page_text: [home] SmileCare Dental Clinic, Kothrud Pune. Painless root canal, braces, implants and kids dentistry. Call us to book an appointment: 020-1234567 (10am to 8pm). Walk-ins welcome but there may be a long wait on Saturdays. [about] Started by Dr. Anjali Kulkarni in 2014. We now have 3 dentists and treat over 40 patients a day. New location opening soon in Baner! [careers] We're hiring a front desk receptionist who can manage phone bookings and patient records in Excel.

[home] Glow Unisex Salon - haircuts, colour, bridal makeup, spa. 2 branches in Indiranagar and HSR Layout. For appointments WhatsApp us or call. [about] Founded by Rohit Sharma in 2019. We are expanding to Whitefield next year. Our stylists are trained in Mumbai. [services] Bridal packages need booking 2 weeks in advance. Too many missed calls during wedding season, please WhatsApp instead.

[home] FitZone Physiotherapy, Andheri West. Sports injury, back pain, post surgery rehab. Book online using our booking page, get reminders on WhatsApp. [about] We use Practo and our own booking system since 2022. Team of 4 physiotherapists.

[home] Sharma Hardware and Sanitary, Sitabuldi Nagpur. Pipes, taps, tiles, paint, tools. Wholesale and retail. [about] Family business since 1988. Stock maintained in register and Excel spreadsheet. GST bills given.

[home] TechWorld Electronics, Ameerpet. Mobiles, laptops, accessories, repairs. EMI available. [about] We have 4 outlets and use an ERP system for billing and inventory across all stores, integrated with our online store.
